title: stale comment in Cargo.toml names pkix-chain-simple after switch to pkix-chain
description: smime-tree/Cargo.toml comment reads: 'pkix-chain-simple and pkix-path use x509-cert 0.2' but both those deps were removed and replaced with pkix-chain. A future reader will look for pkix-chain-simple in the dep list and not find it. Fix: update comment to 'pkix-chain uses x509-cert 0.2'.
